CD PROJEKT RED is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Asset Pipeline Web Services team. We develop web applications and backend services that support game production workflows across the studio, helping teams plan their work, manage assets, review content, and collaborate more effectively.

In this role, you will use your strong Python and backend engineering expertise to design and build reliable services, APIs, and system integrations. You will also contribute to backend services written in Node.js and TypeScript, frontend applications built with React and TypeScript, and the deployment and operation of our solutions in a cloud environment. You will work across the complete application stack, taking features from technical design through production delivery.

We are looking for a hands-on senior engineer who combines technical depth with an ownership mindset and strong collaboration skills. The position is also intended for someone interested in gradually developing toward a coordinator role. Alongside your engineering responsibilities, you will progressively support the organization of the team’s day-to-day work, facilitate communication, and help keep priorities and dependencies visible.

Daily Responsibilities:

• Designing, developing, and maintaining backend services and APIs using Python as well as Node.js and TypeScript.
• Delivering features end to end, from data models and service architecture through React-based user interfaces.
• Making pragmatic architectural decisions and improving the reliability, security, maintainability, and performance of our systems.
• Designing integrations between internal applications, production systems, and external services.
• Participating in the deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting of applications in a cloud environment.
• Collaborating with product, UX, infrastructure, and game development teams to understand their workflows and turn their needs into effective technical solutions.
• Taking ownership of larger areas of work and breaking them down into clear deliverables.
• Gradually taking on selected coordination responsibilities, including helping organize the team’s day-to-day work, facilitating communication, and keeping priorities and dependencies visible.
• Contributing to code reviews, technical documentation, and the continuous improvement of engineering practices.

• 5 + years professional of experience.
• Professional experience in software engineering at senior level, with deep expertise in Python and backend development.
• Experience with FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, or comparable frameworks and libraries.
• Experience designing maintainable APIs, data models, integrations, and service architectures.
• Hands-on experience developing backend services with Node.js and TypeScript.
• Hands-on experience developing frontend applications with React and TypeScript. Deep UI specialization is not required, but you should be comfortable delivering and maintaining complete user-facing features.
• Good working knowledge of relational databases and experience with database systems such as PostgreSQL.
• Experience deploying, operating, or troubleshooting applications in a public cloud environment.
• Understanding of containerization, CI/CD, application monitoring, and production support.
• Understanding of authentication, authorization, secure API design and general web application security.
• Strong software engineering fundamentals, including automated testing, code review, debugging, and maintainable design.
• A strong ownership mindset and the ability to communicate clearly and respectfully in an international, cross-functional environment.
• Interest in gradually developing toward a Coordinator position, supported by strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.

Nice to have:

• Experience with Google Cloud Platform.
• Experience building distributed or event-driven systems using technologies such as Redis or Kafka.
• Experience with infrastructure as code, container orchestration, or cloud-native observability.
• Experience developing internal tools for technical or creative users.
• Experience in game development, media production, digital-content pipelines, or another domain with complex production workflows.

Working mode

• Relocation to Warsaw is required.
• Office-First: working primarily from the Warsaw studio in a full time or hybrid mode.

Relocation Support

• Relocation package – flight ticket, company apartment for your first month, relocating your pet, shipping your belongings — it’s all covered.
• Relocation assistance — processing your legalization operations for you, assistance with finding residence, tax settlements — all you need to feel right at home is taken care of.
• Polish lessons for foreign employees — and for your spouse or partner, too.

Health & Well-Being

• Private medical healthcare — a selection of medical plans with dental care and unlimited rehabilitation to choose from, which are also accessible for your partner and relatives.
• Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones.
• Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company.
• Psychological and psychiatrist care — free mental health support and various well-being webinars.
• Sports card — gain access to a wide number of sporting and fitness facilities across the city.
• Menstrual leave — all menstruating employees are entitled to one day off if they suffer severe period symptoms that interrupt their work.
• RED Parents Network — support for working parents, including childcare benefits, and family-friendly events.
• RED Summer Camp for Kids — a fun summer program for children aged 5–12, majoritively paid by the company.

Perks & Professional Growth

• A welcome pack filled with goodies — to help you feel right at home once you join the team.
• Trainings, lectures, and courses — internal workshops, external training for each employee, knowledge-sharing initiatives, online tutorials, and e-learning classes are all available. There’s always something to learn!
• REDs have access to the cafeteria platform through which they can receive subscription benefits, additional medical packages or vouchers and codes to shops, cinemas, and public transport reimbursement.
• Gifts for newborn rebels and regular chances to nab some cool swag!

Social Activities & Life in the Office

• Dog-friendly office — dog owner? Bring your pooch with you and look after them while working! There’s always a furry friend or two to meet at the studio.
• Social events — we host regular gatherings at the studio where we can all unwind, play games, and just have some fun together.
• Healthy selections — ​​canteens.
• Truly international working environment — a chance to meet and work with a diverse selection of people from all around the world.
• Sustainable campus powered by renewable energy, including electricity from our own solar panels, green zones in offices and on campus, green open-air work and social area, electric and hybrid cars charging points, flower meadows, eco-activities for employees, and much more.
• A designated space for your bicycle, as well as bicycle repair equipment and showers available whenever you need them.
• An onsite, well-equipped gym with a climbing wall, daily Gym Assistant support, and yoga and boxing classes.
• No dress-code — we like to keep it casual.

Estimated pay range for this position: 17,800 - 30,600 PLN gross monthly. Final offers are dependent on job-related factors like experience and qualifications.

We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.
Role Overview
You will be a part of the Observability Engineering team at Coupang to build and maintain monitoring solutions and application performance solutions. The Observability Engineering team's vision is to enable engineering teams to maintain and improve the quality of their services by providing clear visibility about their systems health, intelligence and actionable insights. We build services and tools to help detect, alert, and troubleshoot systems and applications anomalies, with metrics, logs and traces related to the health and reliability of Coupang services. You will have the opportunity to work with hyper-scale systems, build the next generation Observability Platform based on Kubernetes and other OSS solutions, as well as building software components from scratch. You would work directly with various engineering teams in Coupang, influence them with observability principles and best practices and see your impact directly.
What You Will Do
Design, implement, and maintain observability solutions such as monitoring, alerting, logging, and tracing across various platforms, applications, and infrastructure.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including software engineers, SREs, and infrastructure teams, to identify and define observability requirements.
Develop and implement best practices for creating and maintaining effective monitoring, alerting, and telemetry systems.
Evaluate and recommend industry-leading observability tools and technologies to improve system visibility and reliability.
Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and service-level objectives (SLOs) related to system availability, performance, and reliability.
Assist in the troubleshooting and resolution of complex incidents and problems by analyzing data from observability tools.
Provide guidance and mentorship to other engineers on observability principles, practices, and tools.
Conduct ongoing evaluations of observability systems and identify opportunities for improvements and optimizations.
Drive the standardization and simplification of observability processes, tools, and frameworks across the organization.
Contribute to the development of training materials, documentation, and runbooks for observability systems and practices.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Math, or a closely related field
8 years working experience in engineering teams that build large-scale distributed systems
Strong experience in implementing and managing observability solutions in large-scale, complex environments.
Deep knowledge of monitoring, alerting, and logging systems and tools, such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana stack, Elastic stack.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Familiarity with application performance management (APM) tools, such as Dynatrace or AppDynamics.
Professional certifications in cloud platforms, monitoring tools, or related technologies.
Proficiency in at least one programming languages, such as Go, Java, Python, or Ruby.
Familiarity with distributed tracing technologies, such as Jaeger or Zipkin.
Experience with cloud-based infrastructure, including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Strong understanding of DevOps and SRE practices, including continuous integration, continuous delivery, and infrastructure as code (IaC).
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a focus on data-driven decision-making.
A proven track record of leading and delivering successful observability projects and initiatives.

About the Team

OpenAI is building the next generation of advertising for an AI-powered world. As AI changes how people discover information, explore possibilities, and make decisions, we believe this presents a huge opportunity for small and medium-sized businesses to connect with customers in new ways.

The SMB Ads Marketing team is building this opportunity from the ground up. We define how businesses discover OpenAI’s advertising platform, become successful advertisers, and grow their investment over time. Working closely with Product, Ads Engineering, Data Science, and Sales, we combine customer insight, rigorous experimentation, and fast execution to turn early opportunities into scalable growth.

About the Role

The SMB Innovation Sales & Strategy Lead will identify, incubate and scale new revenue opportunities across OpenAI’s SMB Ads business. This foundational role combines strategic thinking, analytical rigor and hands-on execution to develop differentiated customer propositions, validate product opportunities and launch new go-to-market programs.

Working across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing and Data Science, this person will lead initiatives from opportunity assessment through customer discovery, commercial pilots and transition to scale. The remit includes industry-specific opportunities, differentiated customer engagement models and innovative approaches across self-serve, sales-assisted and partner-led channels.

The lead will also partner with SMB leadership and the Strategy & Operations team to inform the overall SMB strategy, contributing customer segmentation, commercial insights and evidence from incubation programs to broader planning and investment decisions.

- Identify untapped opportunities across SMB segments, industries, and channels. Build business cases and launch pilots to validate customer demand and commercial potential.

- Design new acquisition, activation, and expansion programs, including industry-specific and assisted-growth approaches. Partner with sales teams and outsourced sales providers to connect self-serve adoption with sales-assisted engagement.

- Translate customer discovery into product opportunities. Partner with Product and Engineering to evaluate solutions and use customer and commercial evidence to guide investment.

- Develop actionable SMB segmentation based on needs, business characteristics, advertising maturity, behavior, growth potential, and economics. Tailor acquisition, onboarding, service, and expansion across customer channels.

- Own pilot delivery and measurement across incremental revenue, conversion, customer outcomes, and cost to serve. Scale successful programs through clear playbooks and ownership; refine or retire those that miss defined success criteria.

- Shape SMB strategy and investment recommendations with leadership and Strategy & Operations, drawing on market analysis, segmentation, and pilot results.

- Lead the innovation portfolio through clear roadmaps, performance measures, and decision milestones. Resolve delivery challenges and transition proven programs into ongoing operations.

- Understand SMB customers and self-serve business models, including how sales-assisted and partner-led approaches support growth.

- Demonstrate success taking initiatives from customer insight and business case through pilot, launch, and measurable impact.

- Apply strong analytical and financial modeling skills across opportunity sizing, unit economics, funnel analysis, and experimentation.

- Translate customer segmentation into differentiated propositions, engagement models, and investment decisions.

- Work directly with customers to uncover needs and shape product and go-to-market recommendations.

- Lead cross-functional initiatives, align senior stakeholders, and resolve competing priorities.

- Combine strategic analysis with hands-on customer discovery, pilot delivery, and program execution.

- Exercise sound judgment in ambiguous environments and move effectively across complex organizations.

Preferred Experience

- Bring experience in advertising platforms, marketplaces, or SMB technology businesses.

- Combine management consulting experience with substantial hands-on operating responsibility.

- Draw on experience in both established technology companies and startups.

- Build on experience with outsourced sales channels, sales-assisted growth, or industry-specific commercial programs.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Integration Engineering Manager to lead and evolve PlayStation’s Enterprise Integration Engineering capability. You will mentor and develop engineers, foster a strong engineering team culture, and lead the growth of the Enterprise Integration Engineering capability at PlayStation.

Technical Leadership & Architecture

People & Team Leadership

• Develop senior engineers and future technical leaders through coaching, mentoring, and structured career development.

• Drive an inclusive engineering culture focused on accountability, innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement.

jobs.description: Craft: Technology & Development Job Description: Engineering Manager – Game Platform Foundations Are you a natural connector who thrives on developing great people and high-performing teams? You will work across digital channels, content, paid media and social media, partnering with agencies and internal teams to deliver effective marketing programs that support our business priorities and engage customers. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines strategic thinking with strong campaign execution. You do not need to be a technical specialist or an experienced people manager. What matters most is your ability to take ownership of complex digital campaigns, coordinate multiple stakeholders and agencies, and use performance data to improve results. Key Responsibilities Digital and Integrated Campaign Management • Develop and deliver digital and integrated marketing campaigns aligned with business objectives, customer needs and market priorities. • Manage the full campaign lifecycle, from developing the initial strategy and brief through activation, optimization and post-campaign evaluation. • Translate business challenges and customer opportunities into clear marketing objectives, audience strategies, channel plans and measurable outcomes. • Coordinate activity across digital, social media, content, search, paid media and other relevant channels. • Ensure campaigns provide a consistent customer experience and reflect the brand’s positioning, tone of voice and visual identity. • Identify relevant market, consumer, competitor and digital trends that can inform future marketing activity. Content, Media and Agency Management • Develop clear campaign, content, creative and agency briefs based on business and marketing objectives. • Work closely with creative, media, digital, content and social media agencies to deliver high-quality campaigns and assets. • Guide agencies on target audiences, channel selection, content requirements, media planning and campaign KPIs. • Challenge agency recommendations constructively and ensure proposed solutions address the underlying business need. • Oversee content strategy and distribution, ensuring that content is relevant to the audience, platform and stage of the customer journey. • Coordinate paid media activity, including media planning, media buying and campaign optimization. • Manage agency delivery against agreed expectations for quality, timing, budget and results. Search and Social Media • Understand how SEO and Google search contribute to wider digital marketing campaigns. • Work with specialist agencies to set objectives, brief search activity and evaluate recommendations and results. • Support the planning and delivery of organic and paid social media activity across relevant platforms. • Contribute to content plans, campaign calendars, amplification strategies and platform-specific creative development. • Monitor platform developments, audience behaviour and emerging content formats to identify opportunities for improved engagement. Performance and Optimization • Establish clear objectives, KPIs and measurement plans for digital marketing campaigns. • Monitor campaign performance across relevant measures such as reach, engagement, traffic, conversion and cost efficiency. • Use digital analytics and campaign data to identify performance gaps and recommend practical improvements. • Lead campaign performance reviews with agencies and internal stakeholders. • Consolidate campaign results and learnings to strengthen future briefs, channel plans and investment decisions. • Prepare concise reports and presentations that communicate activity, results, key insights and recommended next steps. Stakeholder and Budget Management • Partner with business development, product, communications, sales, customer teams and regional or global marketing colleagues. • Build alignment on campaign objectives, audiences, deliverables, budgets, timelines and measures of success. • Lead cross-functional project teams and maintain momentum across multiple stakeholders and competing priorities. • Manage assigned marketing budgets, agency costs, campaign forecasts and related financial processes. • Ensure that campaigns are delivered on time, within budget and in accordance with brand, legal, privacy and internal approval requirements.
